description_en: Migrates a device to a different instance
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual transfer-device-instance --device-name-list example-string --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --target-instance-id iot-060000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransferDeviceInstance

parameters.help_en: The list of device names to be migrated. A maximum of 100 device names can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 待迁移的设备名称列表。最多包含100个设备名称
parameters.name: device_name_list

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs. This is the unique identifier generated by IoT Platform when the product is created
parameters.help_zh: 设备所属产品的ProductKey，创建产品时，物联网平台为该产品生成的唯一标识
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance to which the device belongs:

Public instance ID: iotx-oxssharez200.
    > Currently, only the China (Shanghai) region is supported, and its instance ID is iotx-oxssharez200.

Enterprise instance ID: Log on to the IoT Platform console. On the Instance Overview page, click the instance name. On the Instance Details page, view the Instance ID in the Instance Basic Information section
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属的源实例ID：

公共实例ID：iotx-oxssharez200。
    > 目前仅支持华东2（上海）地域，其实例ID为iotx-oxssharez200。

企业版实例ID：登录物联网平台控制台，在实例概览页面，单击实例名称，在实例详情页面的实例基本信息中查看实例ID
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target instance to which the device is migrated. Only Enterprise instances are supported as the target instance.

You can log on to the IoT Platform console. On the Instance Overview page, click the instance name. On the Instance Details page, view the Instance ID in the Instance Basic Information section
parameters.help_zh:
设备迁移的目标实例ID。目标实例仅支持企业版实例。

您可登录物联网平台控制台，在实例概览页面，单击实例名称，在实例详情页面的实例基本信息中查看实例ID
parameters.name: target_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code:

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

FailedList.description_en: The list of devices that failed to be migrated

Message.description_en: The description of the migration failure
Message.example: 设备已经转移或不属于来源实例

SuccessList.description_en: The list of devices that were successfully migrated

Message.description_en: The description of the successful migration

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: 来源实例和目标实例不能相同

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
